purpose: Phase C-10 fix: trajectory recording moved to BEFORE the clip/quant step, so cliprate measures the natural rate at which state magnitudes exceed the calibrated r_g. Adds FP32_patched_off condition (patched forward with no intervention) for direct unmodified-recurrence trajectory measurement.
label: Mamba-2.8B-hf

stat_keys: cliprate_pre (fraction of (B, c, s) units exceeding r_b)
cliprate_unit_pre (fraction of (c, s) units exceeded by at least one B element)
protocol.fix_vs_C-10: Recording moved to BEFORE the clip / quant step in the patched forward. cliprate is now pre-clip and measures the natural firing rate. New condition FP32_patched_off (mode='off_record') added: patched forward with no clip/quant and recording active, equivalent to FP16_orig per the C-9 H0 sanity check.

notes: FP32_patched_off PPL is expected to closely match FP16_orig PPL per the C-9 H0 sanity check (the patched function in mode 'off' is bit-for-bit identical to the upstream slow_forward). It serves here as a trajectory-recording reference for the unmodified recurrence.
